title: Emergency contact and teacher workload under the secondary school smartphone ban
asked: Ms Poh Li San asked how schools will handle parents' need for emergency communication with their children under the 2026 secondary school smartphone ban, and how the Ministry will keep teachers from being burdened by checking and enforcing the new rules.
response: Ms Jasmin Lau said MOE had engaged school leaders and provided implementation guidelines, FAQs and examples of good practices. On enforcement, MOE gives schools guidelines to set discipline policies and school rules based on student profiles and needs, and existing rules for smartphone use during lesson time continue to apply. For emergencies, schools have protocols; parents can contact the school's general office, and students can use phones there, so students do not need to own or use a handphone.

key_points.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
key_points.quote: the Ministry of Education (MOE) had engaged school leaders and provided resources such as implementation guidelines, answers to Frequently Asked Questions, and we have also shared good practices by schools that have seen positive outcomes.
